transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Hi. Thanks. I came in because... well, I've been having this issue with eating. Once I start eating alone at night, it feels like something just takes over and I can't stop. Even while I'm sitting there, literally telling myself in my head to just put the food away, I can't do it. I just keep going.
After these episodes, do you do anything to try to prevent weight gain or undo the eating?
Yeah. After I eat like that... I usually end up in the bathroom making myself throw up. It just feels like it's the only way to undo it before the calories settle in.
In a typical week, how many times do these episodes of eating followed by making yourself vomit happen?

I'd say... usually at least once a week. For at least the last four months or so, there's been at least one night each week where I'm home alone, eat way more than I ever meant to, and then... yeah, make myself throw up afterward.
How much do your weight or body shape affect how you feel about yourself?

It affects me a lot, honestly. When I look in the bathroom mirror at my apartment, all I can really focus on is my stomach and my waist. And... if they look wrong to me, I just feel like I've completely failed at being disciplined. 

It kind of overrides everything else. It really doesn't matter how well I did at work at the animal rescue center that day, or what else I accomplished... if my stomach looks bad, I just feel terrible about myself overall.
